cases.script:
hash -p /some/path non-existent-program
hash -t non-existent-program && echo "1. Result: $?"
hash non-existent-program && echo "2. Result: $?"
hash -t non-existent-program && echo "3. Result: $?"
cases.stderr:
/usr/bin/bash: line 3: hash: non-existent-program: not found
/usr/bin/bash: line 4: hash: non-existent-program: not found

cases.script:
hash -p /some/path somecmd && echo "1. Result: $?"
hash -t somecmd && echo "2. Result: $?"

hash -p /some/path somecmd1 && echo "1. Result: $?"
hash -p /some/path somecmd2 && echo "2. Result: $?"
hash -t somecmd1 somecmd2 && echo "3. Result: $?"

hash -p "/some/spaces path" somecmd && echo "1. Result: $?"
hash -t somecmd && echo "2. Result: $?"
hash -t -l somecmd && echo "3. Result: $?"
cases.stdout:
1. Result: 0
/some/spaces path
2. Result: 0
builtin hash -p /some/spaces path somecmd
3. Result: 0

cases.script:
hash -p /some/path somecmd && echo "1. Result: $?"
hash -t somecmd && echo "2. Result: $?"
hash -d somecmd && echo "3. Result: $?"
hash -t somecmd && echo "4. Result: $?"

hash -p /some/path somecmd1 && echo "1. Result: $?"
hash -p /some/path somecmd2 && echo "2. Result: $?"
hash -r && echo "3. Result: $?"
hash -t somecmd1 && echo "4. Result: $?"
hash -t somecmd2 && echo "5. Result: $?"
cases.stderr:
/usr/bin/bash: line 4: hash: somecmd1: not found
/usr/bin/bash: line 5: hash: somecmd2: not found

cases.script:
hash /dev/null && echo "1. Result: $?"
hash /dev/nulll && echo "2. Result: $?"

echo "[empty]"
hash; echo "rc=$?"

echo "[populated, in insertion order]"
hash -p /some/path sc1
hash -p /other/path sc2
hash; echo "rc=$?"

echo "[emptied again]"
hash -r
hash; echo "rc=$?"
cases.stdout:
[empty]
hash: hash table empty
rc=0
[populated, in insertion order]
hits	command
   0	/some/path
   0	/other/path
rc=0
[emptied again]
hash: hash table empty
rc=0

cases.script:
hash -p /some/path sc1
hash -p "/some/spaces path" sc2

hash -l; echo "rc=$?"
cases.stdout:
builtin hash -p /some/path sc1
builtin hash -p '/some/spaces path' sc2
rc=0

cases.script:
hash -p /nonexistent/cat cat
command -v cat; echo "rc=$?"
command -p -v cat; echo "rc=$?"
command -p -V cat; echo "rc=$?"
cases.stdout:
/nonexistent/cat
rc=0
/nonexistent/cat
rc=0
cat is hashed (/nonexistent/cat)
rc=0

cases.script:
hash -p /old tool other
hash -p /new tool
(hash -p /child tool; hash -t tool)
hash -t tool other
hash -d tool
hash -t tool 2>/dev/null; echo status=$?
hash -r
hash
cases.stdout:
/child
tool	/new
other	/old
status=1
hash: hash table empty
